svg.title: The bottega, stage by stage
svg.desc: Six round vignettes in a row, each a stage of a fresco: primo pensiero, a first gesture on a scrap; schizzo, tries side by side, one crossed out; cartone, the clean full-size drawing, squared; spolvero, the drawing pricked and patted with charcoal dust; giornata, a day's patch of plaster painted over the red drawing; affresco, the finished painting.
svg.text: a master and assistants, and a wall reached one drawing at a time
